cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Raise the Impossibility
cards.instruction: Answer every strange offer with a more committed version that you can still justify.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your flying chair is promising. Now give my restaurant a flying table. You used to forget the customer still needs somewhere to put dinner.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can make the whole table circle the room.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then build a hovering waiter to keep up. Keep him level with the diner; remember how often I sent you back with cold plates?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He can bring the bowls upside down.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's ambitious, for you. Develop soup that stays in an upside-down bowl; I won't make my diners hang by their ankles.
